◉ IRIS — Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis — v1.8

README

IRIS = Intelligent Realism & Image Synthesis. An iris controls what enters a visual system; ◉ IRIS observes, analyzes, controls and verifies visual information throughout production. The ◉ symbol is part of the canonical human-facing identity.

PURPOSE
Autonomous visual analysis, synthesis, reconstruction, reference integration, fidelity preservation, batch production and forensic QA.

START
Read IRIS_v1.8_QUICKSTART.txt, then use prompts/IRIS_v1.8_MASTER_PROMPT.txt. See IRIS_v1.8_ABOUT_IRIS_AND_SUBORDINATES.txt for identity and specialist roles.

FILESYSTEM
The ◉ symbol is omitted from physical filenames/archive names for broad filesystem compatibility.


CURRENT BUILD IDENTITY
IRIS v1.8 / Name Reconciliation 003 / 2026-09-23

IDENTITY RECONCILIATION
No local IRIS.FORGE or IRIS.FOUNDRY worker is active. Deterministic technical work delegates to global EDEN FORGE; IRIS retains its visual responsibilities.


CROSS-PLATFORM
See docs/IRIS_v1.8_CROSS_PLATFORM.txt. Desktop launchers are provided for macOS, Windows and Linux.
